name: Craig DeLancey
abstract_title: Teleology and the character of phenomenal events
abstract: Some qualitative aspects of conscious experience appear to correlate with the purposes of the organism. For example, pleasure often accompanies the satisfaction of a purpose, an aversive affect often accompanies failure to achieve one’s purposes, and so on. To explore this relationship, we need a more complete descriptive teleological theory.
